newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Howden wins 200 mln rand power contracts.
newsitem.headline: Howden wins 200 mln rand power contracts.

text.p: South African air and gas handling equipment group Howden Africa Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had won contracts worth 200 million rand for the Majuba power station in the north of the country.
The contracts, which will extend for four years, are to supply and install fabric filter gas cleaning plant, boiler feed and booster pumps.
The firm, which listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange earlier this year, said the contract had been won in the face of stiff local and international competition.

"(The contract) will provide the group with a good base load until the turn of the century and will strengthen the healthy order book reflected by the group when it was listed in May," said managing director Jan Moodie.
The pumps are to be supplied by Howden Weir, a venture with Scottish firm Weir Group Plc.
